findings.title: `queued` is fixed at module-import time instead of source creation time
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated once when the dataclass is defined, so every `AssignmentSource` created by a worker process receives the same `queued` timestamp for the lifetime of that process. This makes the serialized context inaccurately report when an inbound assignment was queued and would break any time-based handling added around this field. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` so each instance records its own creation time.
